name: GNO Recall
author: Gordon Mickel
description: Search your notes, PDFs, documents and code from the Omarchy bar with GNO, an open-source local search engine (https://gno.sh). Recall gives you keyword and semantic search, recent documents and collection browsing in a keyboard-driven overlay. Open matching files directly and check indexing status from the bar.
